summary: A universal macOS 1.0.13 (18) Release bundle was rebuilt. The first fresh build's outer ad-hoc signature did not seal the current App.framework CDHash, so deep verification failed. Re-signing only the outer ad-hoc bundle with its existing Release entitlements repaired verification. The packaging script now performs this repair only for invalid ad-hoc signatures and refuses to replace a failed Developer ID signature.

checks.name: Universal macOS Release compilation
checks.observation: Built BOOHTACORD.app version 1.0.13 (18), 94.7 MB reported by Flutter / 90 MB on disk. Main executable contains x86_64 and arm64 slices.

checks.name: Ad-hoc seal mismatch diagnosis and recovery
checks.observation: The first fresh bundle failed `codesign --verify --deep --strict` with `nested code is modified or invalid` for Contents/Frameworks/App.framework. The nested framework verified standalone; its current CDHash differed from the outer bundle's recorded CDHash. Re-signing only the outer app with the bundle's existing Release entitlements made deep verification pass.

checks.name: Packaging recovery guard tests
checks.observation: The package test verifies an invalid ad-hoc bundle is re-sealed and then accepted, while an invalid Developer ID signature is rejected without invoking the re-sign step. Shell syntax checks pass.

checks.name: Release ZIP and SHA-256 package gate
checks.observation: On a fresh Flutter build, the packager reproduced the stale App.framework CDHash, detected the ad-hoc outer signature, re-sealed the outer app while preserving Release entitlements, and passed deep strict verification. It packaged a 40,067,669-byte ZIP below the 95 MB GitVerse asset ceiling; SHA-256: 24b7a427193666d90e993fe182aa063a4b1fc598da6f895094ad5e9e398e7efa. The test archive is temporary and was not published.

checks.name: Developer ID distribution, notarization and runtime launch/session
checks.observation: No valid Developer ID signing identity is available and the Mac desktop session is locked.

remaining: Provision the macOS release runner and Developer ID credentials, verify a signed/notarized build does not enter the ad-hoc recovery branch, publish via GitVerse, then install and test launch/session persistence on an unlocked Mac.
